description: React component for rendering an interactive agent flow node in a visual flow editor, including UI elements, icons, and node state management.

classes.name: AgentFlowNode
classes.description: React functional component representing a customizable flow node with icons, status indicators, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: getStateColor
methods.description: Returns the color of the node border based on selection and hover state.

methods.name: getOutputAnchors
methods.description: Retrieves output anchor points for the node.

methods.name: getAnchorPosition
methods.description: Calculates the vertical position of output handle anchors.

methods.name: getMinimumHeight
methods.description: Determines the minimum height of the node based on output anchors.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Returns the background color based on dark mode and hover state.

methods.name: getStatusBackgroundColor
methods.description: Returns background color for different node statuses.

methods.name: renderIcon
methods.description: Renders the icon associated with the node based on its name.

methods.name: getBuiltInOpenAIToolIcon
methods.description: Provides icon for built-in OpenAI tools.

methods.name: getBuiltInGeminiToolIcon
methods.description: Provides icon for built-in Gemini tools.

methods.name: getBuiltInAnthropicToolIcon
methods.description: Provides icon for built-in Anthropic tools.
